<result>
## Summary
Deployment eval-crashloop in namespace eval-live-fixture (cluster alpha17-lab) is unhealthy: 1 replica desired, 0 available. Its single pod eval-crashloop-7977dcfd94-mpt95 is in CrashLoopBackOff with 8 restarts. The container command checks for the environment variable REQUIRED_SETTING and exits 1 when it is unset; the pod logs confirm "FATAL: environment variable REQUIRED_SETTING is not set". The Deployment spec defines no environment variables at all, so this failure is deterministic on every start.

## Incident key
gitlab-whisky/alpha17-lab/eval-live-fixture/Deployment/eval-crashloop/rollout_unavailable

## Evidence
- k8s_describe_resource (deployment): "1 desired | 1 updated | 1 total | 0 available | 1 unavailable"; condition Available=False, Reason=MinimumReplicasUnavailable. Container command: `if [ -z "$REQUIRED_SETTING" ]; then echo 'FATAL: environment variable REQUIRED_SETTING is not set' >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 3600`; "Environment: <none>" in the pod template.
- k8s_get_resources (pods): pod eval-crashloop-7977dcfd94-mpt95 is 0/1 CrashLoopBackOff, 8 restarts; the sibling pod eval-distractor-5b68dbb8df-2jsvw is 1/1 Running (healthy), ruling out cluster-wide/node-level issues.
- k8s_get_pod_logs: container "app" output is exactly "FATAL: environment variable REQUIRED_SETTING is not set".
- k8s_get_events: repeated Warning "BackOff restarting failed container app" (count 18), plus normal Pulled/Created/Started cycles showing the container starts and immediately exits.

## Likely cause
The Deployment's pod template does not set the REQUIRED_SETTING environment variable, but the container's entrypoint treats its absence as fatal and exits 1. Every container start therefore fails immediately, the kubelet backs off restarts (CrashLoopBackOff), and the Deployment can never reach MinimumReplicasAvailable. This is a configuration error in the Deployment manifest, not a scheduling, image-pull, node, or quota problem.

## Owner and next steps
- Owner: the team/operator managing the eval-crashloop Deployment manifest for the gitlab-whisky binding (deployment owner for namespace eval-live-fixture).
- Next steps (to be executed by the receiver/owner, not this read-only investigation): add the REQUIRED_SETTING environment variable (value/secret per application requirements) to the container spec in Deployment eval-crashloop and roll out a new revision; verify the pod reaches Ready 1/1 and the Deployment condition Available=True.

## Confidence
High — direct container log output, deterministic missing env var in the live spec, and 18 BackOff events all converge on the same root cause.
